01 / FRAMEWORK

Population size estimation

02 / CHALLENGE

BioDCASE 2026

A 2026 bird-counting challenge using real, multi-species zoo aviary recordings. Dataset, baseline, and results are available.

Explore the challenge ↗
03 / SPECIES RECOGNITION

ARIA

A hybrid BirdNET and PERCH framework for recognizing zoo species in overlapping aviary recordings.
